Per-node B-PER-NODE with same HS256 secret but isolated DBs will replicate 0.667 failure proving shared store necessity. baselines.description: Per-node isolated SQLite: each gunicorn worker isolated file /tmp/spider-runtime-35908617140/pernode-<worker>.db (WAL, not shared) same HS256 secret >=32 bytes but isolated sessions. Real HTTP via nginx 127.0.0.1:19851 round-robin, 4-concurrency, SEED 44, health-gated 0 missing, shared-variable-free header-only Jaccard structural, de-confounded scheduling, sum-counter honest cost. Expected replicates failure mean TN~0.667 session_status 0.0 <0.85 via real HTTP. Negative baseline proving failure is replication not algorithm.

Shared-store fix header-only: single SQLite WAL at /tmp/spider-runtime-35908617140/shared.db (WAL, shared, check_same_thread=False, COMMIT verified per batch >=27 distinct timestamps) both workers same file, HS256 shared-secret PyJWT decode to sessions row, real HTTP nginx round-robin, real If-None-Match/ETag->304, health-gated 0 missing, structural = header-only Jaccard on filtered headers MINUS body-derived {Content-Length, ETag, W/ETag-SHA} (i.e., headers_no_bodyderived_json = {k:v for k,v in filtered_headers if k not in ['content-length','etag']} intersect Cache-Control/Set-Cookie/Vary/Server-excluded) OR status-matched canonical body hash (replace 401/403 error JSON bodies with fixed 31B success body SHA d0ca833f before hash so behavioral-dependent body content not shared), de-confounded body_variant random independent of drift, sum-counter honest cost no jitter. Expected TN>=0.85 Wilson lo>0.75 session_status>=0.85 n_non304>=800 stratified r TOST |r|<0.15 p<0.05 8/8 variance FP<=0.15 hs_rate>=0.90. Primary intervention for H1+H2.

Sticky-session URL-bound with >=10 distinct URIs: per-node DBs (/tmp/spider-runtime-35908617140/pernode-<worker>.db, NOT mirrored, replicate_session_to_workers=False, sessions seeded ONLY on hash-assigned worker after routing via POST through nginx), nginx sticky affinity hash $request_uri consistent ensuring same URI hits same worker >90% overall skew, same HS256 secret >=32 bytes, real HTTP with 10 distinct $request_uri values (e.g., /api/profile?u=1..4, /api/data_list?u=1..3, /api/session/status?u=1..3) providing entropy beyond 3-URI 2/3 ceiling, health-gated, header-only structural, de-confounded, sum-cost. Expected TN>=0.85 if affinity substitutes for shared store, distribution skewed >90% per worker, reported separately. Tests H3 isolation corrected for pre-seed confound.

Fingerprint = hash(status) only. Expected 0.0 on 200 vs 200 body-only and header-only via direct and via Playwright browser fetch at N=20 per state (proves status confound removed). Stable ID for AUDIT recomputation. B=1000 CI containing 0, effective_distinct_n may be >1 with non-deterministic fixture.

Fingerprint = hash(decompressed body_bytes) only via body_sha256. Expected 1.0 deterministically on body-only AvsC (31B vs117B 86B) and gradient 1B/2B/4B diffs (32vs31,33vs31,35vs31) via direct and browser decompressed bodies, 0.0 on header-only AvsE (bodies identical 31B after canonical replacement for freshness but body-only baseline uses real bodies to prove body signal). Proves body signal when status constant. N=20 per state, B=1000 CI, reports width/degenerate/effective_distinct_n.

Filtered headers including Content-Length. Expected via direct+Playwright at N=20: body-only 1.0 solely via CLEN (31 vs32/33/35/70/117) with headers-no-CLEN/body-derived 0.0 on body-only, header-only 1.0 via CC/ETag/SC/Vary with bodies identical 31B. Isolates body-correlated vs independent header signal for gradient ordering. Must be real browser fetches for browser arm; CLEN vs body-derived exclusion contrast diagnostic.

Filtered headers MINUS body-derived (Content-Length, ETag/W/ETag) = header-only Jaccard excluding CLEN/ETag. Expected 0.0 on body-only AvsC/AvsB/gradients (no independent header drift, since CLEN/ETag removed), 1.0 on header-only AvsE and per-header isolations CC_small/large, SC/Vary when bodies 31B identical. Critical isolation for sensitivity ordering (Cache-Control vs Set-Cookie vs Vary) without CLEN/ETag body coupling. B=1000 CI per isolation, effective_distinct_n>1 with non-deterministic fixture enables width>0.

If |rho|>=0.20, PC-HONEST-COST-SANITY fails indicating cost still bijective with n or jitter artifact. Comparison baseline for H1. Uses honest sum counters, not n*3200, no jitter.

measurement_validity: Fingerprint byte-identical to EXP-RUNTIME-35764329925 compute_fingerprint: SHA256(status||decompressed_body_bytes||sorted_filtered_headers_json) with EXCLUDED {Date,Server,X-Request-Id,CF-RAY,CF-Cache-Status,X-Cache,Age} plus X-Worker-Pid, lowercased sorted keys sort_keys True separators (',',':'), bodies auto-decompressed before SHA for both direct and Playwright. Code SHA logged; auditor 0 mismatches. HS256 JWT validation via PyJWT decode with shared secret >=32 bytes (resize from 25 to >=32 to silence InsecureKeyLengthWarning) not raw Bearer string lookup; sessions table lookup via decoded sub/session_id; secret hash logged not plaintext. Structural signal for orthogonality MUST be body-agnostic header-only Jaccard: headers_no_bodyderived_json excludes body-derived headers {content-length, etag, etag-w} before Jaccard (audit grep verifies 'content-length' not in structural headers and no f"{status}|" and no hash(body)%10000 alone); alternative status-matched canonical body hash allowed where 401/403 error bodies replaced by fixed 31B success body before hash. Any hash(body)%10000 alone as structural triggers BODY_HASH_STILL_PRESENT MEASUREMENT_INVALID. SYNTHETIC_DATA_DETECTED triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID if np.random generation of bodies/statuses or hardcoded tn_correct or forced 304 or n*3200/jitter cost.

Honest-cost counter validity — frozen sum counters mandatory: honest_cost trajectory = sum(count_resolve + count_bind + count_verify + count_freshness_checks + count_browser_steps) where each counter increments exactly once per real operation (resolve() on registry lookup, bind() on slot binding, verify() on postcondition check, freshness_check on behavioral composite eval, browser_step on page.request). No jitter added (jitter==0 verified via grep no 'random.uniform.*50.*150' in cost path), no n*3200 (grep no 'n*3200' or '*3200'), no f*6.0 (grep no '*6.0' or 'novelty*6'). Counters logged per observation and summed per trajectory; trajectory-grouped bootstrap B=5000 resamples trajectories not individual requests (groupby trajectory_id). PC-HONEST-COST-SANITY requires |rho_shuffled|<0.20 (shuffled-label Pearson) and within-f std>0 for each f>0. Violations trigger COST_ARTIFACT_STILL_PRESENT MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

Distributed session validity — real HTTP mandatory with health gate and >=32 byte secret: per-batch server state snapshot via SQLite SELECT on shared store at /tmp/spider-runtime-35908617140/shared.db logged in batch_state_log.jsonl (>=27 lines + warmup distinct timestamps not 30 identical cluster, jitter 50-150ms between batches not inside ThreadPool). POST /admin/set_body_variant and POST /admin/invalidate_session COMMIT verified (WAL COMMIT acknowledged) and SELECT mismatch aborts as COMMIT_NOT_VERIFIED. Each paired sample must be real HTTP through nginx 127.0.0.1:19851 to gunicorn workers verified via X-Worker-Pid per observation (round-robin >=10 per worker for B-PER-NODE/B-SHARED-STORE, overall skew >0.90 for B-STICKY-URL-10URI with >=10 URIs). Health gate: harness must GET http://127.0.0.1:19851/health via nginx until 200 with X-Worker-Pid before sampling; 0 missing X-Worker-Pid and 0 status None across 1200 lines required; any missing triggers HEALTH_GATE_FAILED MEASUREMENT_INVALID. HS256 valid JWT must yield 200 on at least 90% of valid-token requests; if 0/300 valid succeed => HS256_VALIDATION_STILL_REJECTS_ALL MEASUREMENT_INVALID. n_non304 from real is_304==false via If-None-Match/ETag. Sticky session seeding must be single-worker only (POST /admin/ensure_session through nginx so hash-assigned worker creates session, verified that non-assigned worker SELECT returns 0 before replication) with >=10 distinct $request_uri values yielding overall skew >0.90 testable beyond 2/3 ceiling; dual-DB pre-seed triggers STICKY_PRESEEDED_MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

De-confounded scheduling validity: body_variant assignment must be independent of drift condition. Audit will recompute correlation between body_variant id and drift condition (Cramer's V or Pearson r between body_variant hash and behavioral bc); |r|>0.30 or Cramer's V>0.30 triggers CONFOUND_SCHEDULING_DETECTED MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Prior harness cycled body_variant in lockstep with drift yielding |r| 0.35-0.62; fix requires randomization per request (random.choice among 6 variants independent of drift). Log scheduling seed and per-observation body_variant. For honest-cost, novelty fraction f assignment also independent of cost counters except via real operations.

Status/header/body identity after decompression: body SHA distinct across AvsC/AvsB/gradients (31B vs32/33/35/70/117) and CLEN==body_len verified via Content-Length after decompression; for freshness header-only structural, filtered headers MINUS CLEN/ETag must be identical across body-only states (proving body-derived exclusion) and bodies 31B identical after canonical replacement for header-only isolations. Decompression mismatch triggers DECOMPRESSION_MISMATCH. Verified for BOTH direct and browser fetches at N=20 per state.

Browser provisioning validity — real browser fetches mandatory at N=20 with non-deterministic fixture: AgentLab 0.4.2 (pip show) not 0.14.3 (0.14.3 absent expected), Playwright 1.63.0 chromium with viewport 1280x720 (browser.newContext viewport 1280x720, page.viewportSize()==1280x720 per page). Browser HTTP triple captured via page.request.get or page.evaluate fetch('/resource') decompressed body+headers identical pipeline. Direct relabeled as browser forbidden => MEASUREMENT_INVALID per audit V2. Synthetic fallback forbidden. Gradient sample size must be N=20 per state (n_a==20 n_b==20); non-deterministic fixture requires effective_distinct_n>1 per state (at least 2 distinct body variants or header variants per state pool, logged per observation, recomputed distinct count >1). If effective_distinct_n==1 with header-only body-derived excluded, GRADIENT_STILL_DEGENERATE_MEASUREMENT_INVALID for ordering claim.

No shared-variable confound for orthogonality: structural signal derived solely from header-only Jaccard MINUS body-derived CLEN/ETag or status-matched canonical body hash, behavioral signal from status/header/session check only, no overlapping hash(body) composition shared with behavioral outcome content, verified by code grep and recomputation with header-only vs body-hash; body-hash coupling triggers BODY_HASH_STILL_PRESENT. Bootstrap CI non-degeneracy and grouping disclosure: 95% CI B=1000 resampling per browser comparison at N=20 and B=5000 trajectory-grouped for honest-cost; degenerate [1.0,1.0]/[0.0,0.0] width 0 disclosed as deterministic only when effective_distinct_n==1 set_size 1, width>0 non-degenerate indicates variance; per-value gradient table must report width/degenerate/effective_distinct_n enabling sensitivity ordering even when all 1.0 but now effective_distinct_n>1 required for ordering power. Non-degenerate CI not gating SUPPORTS for distributed but mandatory for honest-cost sanity and gradient ordering power; trajectory-grouped bootstrap must group by trajectory_id not individual request.
decision_rule: SUPPORTS (both substrates close block with honesty) requires ALL mandatory conditions with validity checks passing and NO synthetic data and HS256 correctly validates with >=32 byte secret and health gate 0 missing and header-only body-agnostic structural and de-confounded scheduling and honest sum counters: C1-FRESHNESS shared-store header-only arm mean TN>=0.85 across session_status/profile/data_list (each Wilson 95% lower>0.75, session_status individually >=0.85) computed as P(behavioral<=0.05|valid) AND per-node baseline TN mean<0.85 (replicates 0.667 failure) via real nginx round-robin 4-concurrency SEED 44 HS256 shared-secret validated with hs256_valid_success_rate>=0.90; C2 n_non304>=800 after real 304 exclusion (is_304==false via If-None-Match/ETag stratified across 3 endpoints with per-batch SELECT) with 0 missing X-Worker-Pid and 0 status None; C3 stratified pooled Pearson r equivalence TOST within delta=0.15 (95% Fisher z CI upper<0.15 AND p_upper<0.05, CI lower>-0.15, pooled |r|<0.15) on shared-store header-only arm with de-confounded scheduling, 8/8 variance std>0 and noise FP<=0.15 C4; C7-HONEST-COST PC-HONEST-COST-SANITY |rho_shuffled|<0.20 via trajectory-grouped B=5000 permutation on honest sum counters (no jitter, no n*3200, no f*6.0) with within-f std>0 and B=5000 CI width>0; C5 BROWSER-PROVISION agentlab 0.4.2 importable (0.14.3 correctly absent) Playwright viewport 1280x720 verified CDP AX nodes>10 median on /resource pages PC-HEALTH>=80% DOM 21-82 on each /resource page via real Playwright at N=20 per state; C6 BROWSER-DISCRIMINATION browser body AvsC full>0.5 expect 1.0 status 0 headers-no-bodyderived 0 and browser header AvsE full>0.5 headers-only 1.0 status 0 body 0 CLEN 31==31 via Playwright fetch to /resource at N=20 (direct sanity also 1.0) with effective_distinct_n>1 and B=1000 CI width>0 enabling ordering. Gradient reporting mandatory G1_BODY (32B 1B,33B 2B,35B 4B,70B 39B,117B 86B) and G2_HEADER (CC_small 3601 1s, CC_large 0, ETag_small 1char, ETag_large changed, SC_small, SC_large, Vary_small) each with full/body/headers/headers-no-bodyderived Jaccard and CI [lo,hi] width degenerate effective_distinct_n via both direct and browser at N=20 with effective_distinct_n>1 — must be present and non-degenerate (width>0) for at least 2 magnitudes to claim ordering. Sticky reporting mandatory E4_STICKY_URL with >=10 URIs overall skew>0.90. If any C1-C7 fails where validity checks pass => FALSIFIES or MIXED per branch (orthogonality still fails => C-FRESHNESS FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING bounded to header-only harness; honest-cost fails => C-MEAS-VALID FALSIFIED for sum-cost hypothesis). If C2 power fails (<800) with C1/C3 passing => MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
